# Passover 2026: When Does Passover Start?
March 26, 2026

In 2026, Passover begins at sundown on April 1 and ends on April 9.

## When Is Passover 2026?
| Year | Passover Begins (at sundown) | Passover Ends (at nightfall, when 3 medium stars become visible) |
|-|-|-|
| 2026 | Wednesday, April 1 | Thursday, April 9 |

Nissan 14 was the Passover as mentioned in the Torah; at this time, an offering was made to the Lord—the sacrifice of a lamb, which was slaughtered and prepared during the afternoon. Nissan 15 (the new day starting at sundown) was the beginning of the seven-day Festival of Unleavened Bread. At the start of Nissan 15, the Passover lamb was eaten, along with unleavened bread.
